description: This file implements CUDA device connectivity detection, specifically NVLink and NVSwitch connections, for PyTorch's distributed memory management.

classes.name: NVLinkDetector
classes.description: Detects NVLink and NVSwitch connectivity between CUDA devices.

classes.name: RegisterDetector
classes.description: Registers the NVLinkDetector as a DMA connectivity detector for CUDA devices.

methods.name: detect
methods.description: Detects NVLink and NVSwitch connections and returns a DMAConnectivity object.

methods.name: get_bus_id
methods.description: Retrieves the PCI bus ID for a given device index.
